_comment: Brazil's jurisdiction table. Authority NAMES are real and public; every EMAIL
here is a non-routable placeholder on the reserved .invalid TLD, on purpose, so
that a misconfigured run cannot reach a real regulator. Real addresses belong
in authorities.br.json, which overrides this file and is not committed.
Keys are state and city names as reverse geocoding returns them; case and
accents are folded on both sides, so 'Pará' and 'para' are the same key.
Who acts is decided by Lei Complementar 140/2011: enforcement follows
licensing (arts. 7, 8 and 9, item XIII), and art. 17 §1 lets any identified
person bring a representation to the licensing body. Most licensing, and the
authorisation a controlled burn needs, sits with the state environmental
agency, so most categories resolve to the state. IBAMA is the federal body and
the escalation for every state; its Prevfogo centre handles fire.
State agency names were checked against each agency's own site or the state
legislature. Pará's SEMAS was renamed Secretaria de Estado de Meio Ambiente,
Clima e Sustentabilidade by state law 10.989 of 2025. Municipal secretariats
are listed only where the current name could be confirmed; Belém's and
Cuiabá's could not, and are left out rather than guessed.
No Brazilian environmental law sets a deadline for answering a complaint, so
every response_window_days is null and the lookup uses follow_up_days instead,
marked as not statutory.

crop_residue_burning.statute: Lei 14.944/2024 (Política Nacional de Manejo Integrado do Fogo)
crop_residue_burning.section: Art. 30, fire in vegetation only with authorisation or in the cases listed, and art. 45, liability for irregular use of fire; setting fire to vegetation is also a crime under art. 41 of Lei 9.605/1998
crop_residue_burning.response_window_note: No Brazilian law sets a deadline for an environmental agency to answer a complaint. Lei 13.460/2017 gives public-service ombudsman channels 30 days, but it covers complaints about a public service, not about a polluter. The interval shown is this system's suggested follow-up, not a statutory period.

industrial_emission.section: Art. 3, III, pollution, and art. 14 §1, the polluter's liability regardless of fault; brought as a representation under art. 17 §1 of Lei Complementar 140/2011
